plain: In 1969, before he became US president, Jimmy Carter is said to have seen a UFO. A guest named Dan Sheehan tells it second-hand, saying Carter was with "11 other people" standing "on the steps of this Lion's Club," a local civic club in Georgia, when they saw it. A researcher who goes by the name RedPandaKoala tells it as Carter describing "a bright light" that appeared "in the distance" in the western sky. Michels repeats Sheehan's words on another episode, that Carter "had seen a UFO in 1969." It matters because it would put a future president among those who say they saw something unexplained.
